title: DEATH ZO
text: “Huh… Well, then…”
My father looked at me and furrowed his brow. As for why he was furrowing his brow, it seems he thought I was about to cut Crimson Swine loose and invite another woman to the party instead.

So, we were ushered out of the Throne Room, leaving my Father and the others behind, and each of us went to rest in our respective guest rooms. I know what’s coming—my Father is about to bestow their true names on Crimson Swine and Trash. Heh heh heh… Well, in the meantime, I’ve got a few things of my own to take care of.

Come to think of it, where are Lazy Pig and Crimson Swine’s henchmen? Lazy Pig aside, those henchmen are a hassle, so I’d like to get rid of them all at once… but that guy doesn’t really leave much of an impression. Well, since they won’t be able to do anything once Crimson Swine falls from grace, I suppose I can just ignore them. But more importantly, I need to get moving right away!
I’m heading straight to the inn in the town below the castle to meet the Immortal Filolial, who’s been waiting for me there.
“Well now, Spear Hero, I’ve heard rumors that the incident is finally being resolved. I’m so glad to see you’re doing well.”
“No need to worry. Fleon-chan is doing just fine, too. So, there’s a party being held at the castle, and I’d like you to come as well.”
“M-Me? But…”
“It’ll be fine. Those who took Fleon-chan from you have already been punished. This is also a way for them to apologize.”
“I see. In that case, I shall accept the Spear Hero’s kind invitation.”
And so, I brought the Hermit along to the party at the castle.
“They’re still getting ready, but if you wait a bit, it’ll start soon enough.”
“Oh? Spear Hero, who is that?”
The Queen addressed me right then.
“Ah, I’m sorry for the delay in explaining. This is the person I wanted to bring to the banquet.”
“Is that so…? That’s a bit surprising. I didn’t expect the Spear Hero to bring such an elderly gentleman.”
True, back then I was constantly chasing after a pig’s rear end. I’m sure the Queen must have known that from reports by the Shadows and others.
“This is the person I—Aka—Bi…”
Ugh… No matter which way I call the Crimson Swine, it sounds unnatural.
“This is the elderly gentleman I’ve caused trouble for by requesting a Filolial. Believe it or not, he’s actually Fleon-chan’s original owner.”
“What! That’s… I’ve heard about it in reports. It’s the flying Filolial that was supposed to be extinct, isn’t it?”

The Queen’s eyes lit up. Ah, come to think of it, the Queen has always taken a deep interest in legends and such. She must be intrigued by hearing about Fleon-chan, a Filolial that was supposed to be extinct.
“I see… So you’re the one that child caused trouble for… I am the queen of this country. On behalf of Melromarc, I offer my sincere apologies.”
“N-no… You’re too kind…”
The hermit seems a bit uncomfortable; he’s scratching his head and bowing along with the queen as she apologizes.
“But I’ve seen you somewhere before…”
“Ah… yes. A long time ago, I arranged for military Filolials to be supplied to Melromarc. Her Majesty was still a child back then, so I’m honored that you remember me.”
“Well… if that’s the case, I see.”
With that, the Queen began speaking to the Sage with a gentle smile.
Now then… isn’t it about time? I’ve been waiting for this moment.
――TIME TO PUT THE PLAN INTO ACTION, DEATH ZO.
I discreetly stepped away from the Immortal and the Queen, layered the Cloaking Lance with Magic to further conceal myself, and kept watch on the castle kitchen.
And then… there they were. The Crimson Swine, whose equipment had been confiscated, was sauntering along with Trash… I’d been waiting for this very moment.
“Oink! Oink-oink! O-oink?”
“I’m here too. Excuse me.”
“Huh? Maru—no, Bitch…? And O… no, Trash… The dish to be served to the Shield Hero is that one over there, but…”

The Crimson Swine and Trash are furrowing their brows in displeasure at the cook’s reply. That’s right. The Crimson Swine and Trash have already been forced to change their names. HAHAHA! What a humiliating embarrassment!
“Oink! Oink-oink! Oink-oink-oink!”
“That’s right, we’ve reflected deeply on our actions. This is our atonement.”
“But—…”
Seizing the moment, the cook signals his subordinate with a glance and sends him off to report to the Queen.
“That’s why we’re the ones who’ll carry the food out to the shield! We won’t tolerate any interference!”
“Oink!”
And with that, Crimson Swine and Trash—almost forcefully—reach for the plates meant for their dad and dash right out of the kitchen. I stay in stealth mode and run alongside Crimson Swine and Trash.
“Oink!”
Crimson Swine sticks out his tongue and oinks. It definitely looks like he’s saying, “Just kidding!”
“That’s right! Even if there are just the two of them, we can’t let them use a shield like that! Let’s go, Malty!”
“Oink! Oink!”

As they ran with the plates, Crimson Swine and Trash each pulled a bottle from their pockets and began serving food onto the plates. Needless to say, these two are lacing the food with poison. But this is the moment I’ve been waiting for! Keeping pace with the Crimson Swine… I’ll add a certain poison to the plate.
The name of that poison is—Uroboros Deadly Venom.

It is the most difficult poison to create among the recipes found within the Unleashed Spear. If Yggdrasil Potions are considered the “Light of the World,” hailed as miracle cures, then this Uroboros Deadly Venom is said to be the “Darkness,” the crystallization of malice—its polar opposite. It’s said to be something that’s only ever been passed down by word of mouth, and even Zeltoble himself erased any records of its manufacturing method—yet it does exist within the Holy Weapon’s crafting functions.

Of course, making it was a huge undertaking, but I managed to create it by hunting griffins and “borrowing” various materials from the castle’s storerooms. I even had my Rival produce some of the ingredients for me.
I’m pouring this poison liberally into the plate the Crimson Swine is about to eat from. I’ll pop the cap off the bottle with a “pop.”
――Danger!

A warning suddenly popped up in my field of vision, but it’s fine! After all, it’s the Crimson Swine who’s drinking it. I just went ahead and poured my own poison into the same plate as the Crimson Swine was adding his.

Heh heh heh… Just as my Father taught me: “An eye for an eye.” This is a fitting end for you, the one who poisoned Fleon-chan. It wouldn’t make any sense if it were easily neutralized. Now, suffer and die! Since it’s surely an incredibly potent poison, they won’t be able to neutralize it and will die after a long, agonizing struggle.
By the way, I hear this poison is actually meant to be diluted before use. According to Rival, I should have diluted it a thousand times to get the outcome I wanted.
Eventually, Crimson Swine and Trash made their way from the kitchen to the castle’s great hall.
“What a noble gesture to bring the food.”

The queen, who had been preparing for the party and giving instructions, was waiting there. Of course, we all know exactly how this is going to play out. Just as Crimson Swine and Trash were about to seize the moment and place the plates on Father’s seat, they were arrested by soldiers on the queen’s orders.
“W-What are you doing?!”
“Ooooh!”
Then, the queen confronted Crimson Swine and Trash.
“We didn’t do anything! We were just bringing the food!”
Even I, running alongside them, could tell that was a complete lie.
“Well, I hope nothing is amiss. Now then, have a bite… Eat the dish you were about to serve to Lord Iwatani.”
“I wouldn’t do something so rude!”
“Oink-oink-oink!”
After that, it seems Trash and the Crimson Swine made several excuses.
“Yes, I believe you. So eat it.”
“But that would be disrespectful to the shield!”
“Bubuhi! Buhee-buhee-bububub!”
“It’s fine. I’ll just take a tiny bit onto a clean plate.”
“No way!”
“Buhiiii!”
“Make him eat it!”
After that exchange… Trash and Crimson Swine were each forced to eat the contents of the plates they’d carried.
“Ugh…”
Gurgle, gurgle, gurgle… Trash’s stomach began to growl.

“B… B… 
At that very moment, Crimson Swine shook off the soldiers’ restraints and began writhing on the ground, clawing at his throat.
“You fool… So you were trying to poison me after all…!?”

Just as the Queen—who had raised her hand to administer an antidote—was about to act, she fell silent, and Trash stood there dumbfounded at the sight. Just as I thought, just as I thought. This is the Crimson Swine’s fate! Serves him right, aaaaaaa!
“AAAAaaaaaa—”
Soon, the Crimson Swine stopped moving, twitching and moaning. HAHAHA… It’s more effective than I expected. It’s a powerful poison, and I’d assumed he’d suffer a bit longer before dying.
“O-oink? O-oink! O-oink!?”

Oh? A pig—one of the Crimson Swine’s kind… what was its name again? It’s been so long I’m starting to forget—but this pig is worried about the Crimson Swine and is shaking it. So that’s where you were. I’ll take care of you properly later.
“Oo-oink!? Ooo-oink-aaah GAAAAA!?”

Hmm? Something seems off here. The Crimson Swine’s body is changing color. On top of that, some strange, vine-like growths of flesh have started to sprout. And those vines have wrapped around the pig that was shaking the Crimson Swine, consuming it and causing vines to grow out of its back.
……Hmm? I just caught a glimpse of a pig heading toward the wall.

I don’t know which one it is, but I won’t let it get away… Oh, that’s the Lazy Pig! Just when I was wondering what it was up to, it’s sprinting away from the Crimson Swine at incredible speed. Right now, it’s pressed right up against the wall, watching to see how things play out.

While the other pigs got caught up in it, the Lazy Pig managed to escape. What kind of crisis-avoidance skills does it have? No—put another way, maybe the situation is so dire that even the Lazy Pig feels this much danger.
――Danger! ――Danger! ――Danger!
Countless warning messages are popping up all over my screen. I know it’s dangerous, but do they really appear over such a wide area? Does that mean it’s not just some ordinary poison?

The warnings are so intense that it’s almost as if the system recognizes this as “an enemy the Holy Weapon must defeat.” Well, I’m the Hero, after all—the one who teamed up with my Rival to create it. But even though I’ve faced plenty of dangerous situations before, I don’t think I’ve ever seen this many warnings pop up at once…
“M-Malty! Martiiiiiiiiiiiiii!”
And with that, the Trash’s bloodcurdling scream echoed through the air. The commotion inside the castle began to grow. At the same time, I was taken completely by surprise.
“Hey! What on earth just happened?”
Just then, my Father came rushing over from the direction of the great hall’s door. He looked pretty flustered.
“Actually, the poison detection and that mysterious warning message are so intense they’re filling up my entire field of view, just like in some boss battle…”
He had a look of utter desperation on his face. To avoid arousing suspicion, I pretended to have just rushed in from behind and joined him.
“Did something happen? Those warnings are pretty intense.”
“…Motoyasu?”
“Master! Don’t go any further from here! I’m getting the creeps!”
“Yeah… No matter how you look at it, this is way beyond just a strange vibe!”
Both Filo-tan and her Big Sister have their hackles up. If Filo-tan—who is, after all, Filolial-sama—is saying that, things must be pretty dire.
Hmm… If I were to say something like, “I poisoned the Crimson Swine☆,” I’m afraid this wouldn’t just be a joke. Alright, let’s stay quiet here as planned.
“What is this? What’s going on?”
“What’s this vibe!?”
Itsuki and Ren have also rushed to the scene. Is the warning being issued over such a wide area?
“Huh? What’s this? Isn’t this seriously bad?”
Black Thunder said something—for the first time, in a somewhat coherent way.
“It’s a dangerous vibe! Everyone, let’s be careful!”
On the other hand, Fleon-chan is her usual self. She probably doesn’t really understand what’s going on.
“No way… no way… this can’t be happening!”
That Trash is flustered here, acting like he knows what’s going on.
“That can’t be! There’s no way something like this could happen, aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
The Queen forcefully dragged Trash away from the Crimson Swine’s corpse… to keep him at a distance. Then, in a tense voice, she shouted:
“All hands! Evacuate immediately! Those skilled in combat and our heroes! Prepare for battle!”
“What on earth is going on?”
“We can’t afford to take our time! This is an emergency! If we don’t deal with this immediately, the kingdom could be destroyed!”
Is it really that serious? It seems a bit over the top to me.

While I was thinking that, the Crimson Swine and what used to be its pig companions began twitching and writhing. After their forms completely disintegrated, they turned into countless flesh-like vines and began spreading out into the surrounding area.
Huh? The monster’s name just popped into my head. So it was a poison that turns creatures into monsters, was it? The name is…
“—The Apostle of Ouroboros?”
Father was the first to say the name of what used to be the Crimson Swine.
